round: Answers the tester's failure (test.json failures[0], https://github.com/sjawhar/legion/pull/2228#issuecomment-6408420209): a card omp held behind a streaming turn was recorded shown at once and lost when the process ended.

proof.criterion: Outcome: an event reaches the session once when it comes back under the same session id, including a card omp held behind a streaming turn when the process ended (the tester's failure)
proof.surface: real `omp --mode rpc` session (workspace pi-envoy via -e, scratch HOME, file sessions), real nats-server with JetStream (packages/envoy/internal/testnats/cmd/natsd -js) and the listener built from this head, the session's NATS behind a socat proxy
proof.observed: long turn started (get_state isStreaming true); dispatch-1792992898836 and -837 published live and held by omp (queuedMessageCount 2, card=0); proxy killed, -838 and -839 stored, proxy restarted, replay handed them over mid-turn (queuedMessageCount 4); session file card=0 for all four; omp SIGKILLed; resumed on the same session file: once idle card=1 for each of the four, still card=1 three heartbeats later
proof.negativeControl: the released plugin /opt/legion/pi-envoy/dist/envoy.js (10.17.7) through the same live-during-turn + SIGKILL path: dispatch-1792992898840 and -841 card=0 after the resumed session went idle (lost)

proof.criterion: Live proof: break a real Oh My Pi session's NATS connection, publish an event to its own topic, restore the connection, and show the event in the session's transcript with no second copy
proof.surface: same real omp session and stack
proof.observed: with natsd /connz?subs=1 showing no connection for the session, dispatch-1792992898832 published through JetStream with Nats-Msg-Id; 1 s after the proxy restarted exactly one envoy-message entry for it, still one three heartbeats later
proof.negativeControl: released plugin 10.17.7: no entry for dispatch-1792992898834 published the same way, five heartbeats after the proxy restarted, while its live -835 showed at once

proof.criterion: Outcome: an event published while the session was stopped reaches it once when it resumes under the same session id
proof.surface: same real omp session and stack, omp stopped and resumed on the same session file
proof.observed: dispatch-1792992898833 published while omp was stopped appeared as exactly one entry 0 s after --resume, still one three heartbeats later, and leg 1's entry still one
proof.negativeControl: released plugin 10.17.7 shows no entry for an event published while its connection was down (control leg of the same run)

proof.criterion: Automated: the tester's red tests and the outage, failure and notice cases
proof.surface: pi-envoy extension under the mocked host (which now writes a card only when it takes it) with /v1/replay served from an in-test stream model; envoy-client engine with a fake stream
proof.command: cd packages/pi-envoy && bun test extensions/envoy.test.ts -t "a card the host had not written" (2 pass, unmodified from 6e3e5519); cd packages/pi-envoy && bun test (944 pass); cd packages/envoy-client && bun test (861 pass)

filesChanged: packages/envoy-client/src/replay.ts: `queued` delivery outcome (no record, no failure count, hole), notice may be `queued`, exported `replayLedgerIdentity`; tests

packages/pi-envoy/extensions/envoy.ts: `sendCard` puts the frame's identity in the card's `details`; cards, failure notices and the person's turns stay pending (dedupe claim) until omp's `message_end` for that message, then `recordDelivered` + settle; pending frames of a session left on a switch are settled unrecorded
packages/pi-envoy/src/missed-messages.ts: `replaySnapshot` also reads back every written envoy-message card (`writtenCardIdentity`, from details or the rendered `id:` / `event_id:` line)

packages/pi-envoy/extensions/envoy.test.ts: harness models omp writing a card only when it takes it (`turn: idle|streaming`, `take()`); two restart tests boot idle; six new tests; the red describe untouched
packages/pi-envoy/scripts/smoke-replay.sh and README.md: leg 3 and its control
packages/claude-envoy/dist/envoy-channel.js rebuilt; docs: pi-envoy AGENTS.md, envoy-client README, both CHANGELOGs, docs/site dispatch/envoy.md
trickyParts: Measured on omp 18.8.9: a card sent while a turn streams fires no event and is not in the file until the turn ends; then each gets message_start/message_end and its custom_message entry (details kept). Idle, message_end follows within ~25 ms. A SIGKILL before then leaves nothing. After an abort the queued cards are written.
A frame omp withdraws and never writes keeps its claim pending for the process's life: its subject's cursor stays before it (re-read each sweep) and the restarted session shows it.
deviations: claude-envoy keeps its documented boundary (the channel or bridge-inbox write succeeding counts as shown); only its dist was rebuilt.
claude-envoy tests/session-title.test.ts 'queryTmux is bounded even by a tmux that ignores SIGTERM' fails intermittently on this pod (1 of 3 isolated runs, 5 s bun timeout); untouched by this change.
